items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: Arthur Derby is a violin player he was with me.

ctx.x: Let me see what time could that have been. He didn't stay too long. He was playing with me and another fellow came in. Let me see the name of my 20th player. He was playing with saxophone and Derby. He's dead. Arthur Derby is a violin player he was with me.
Derby is alive I believe. Is he?
